injuries.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.
Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.
Schroder (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against the Wizards.
Knueppel (hamstring) will practice with the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Thursday, the Hornets announced.

Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Friday's game against the Heat.

Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
